block.guhs.mega_knuffelcentrale.lore: A giant 5 by 3 cushion where 16 tamed guhs cuddle together: 22 vadskracht per guh, up to 352 in all. Do look after them: knabbels, pink buns or blocks of kaasknabbels, and one wool a day for fresh blankets. One per net.
gui.guhs.centrale.leeg: No guh on the giant cushion yet: tamed guhs within %s blocks come by themselves
gui.guhs.centrale.honger: Hungry! Without food they only cuddle at %s percent
gui.guhs.centrale.dekens_oud: The blankets are not fresh any more: %s percent. One wool a day, vads!
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bronnen_: Let guhs cuddle on a Mega Cuddle Plant
advancements.guhs.techniek.centrale_expo: Sell bulk to a guh villager for something rare
